description: Edits the appearance or content of a supplied video segment using a text prompt. Use with a source video, the requested changes and the clip end time. Starts a background job that costs credits; returns a project id for wait_for_video_project. Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable.

assets.description: Provide the assets for video editing.

video_file_path.description:
The video to edit. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

end_seconds.description: End time of your clip in seconds. Must be greater than `start_seconds`. Allowed duration depends on model: `gemini-omni-1.1`: 3-10s, `wan-3.0`: 2-15s, `ltx-2.5`: 0.5-60s (30s at 1080p).

model.description: Editing model. Defaults to LTX 2.5 for free tier and `gemini-omni-1.1` for paid. `wan-3.0` requires a paid tier. `gemini-omni` is deprecated; use `gemini-omni-1.1` instead.

name.description: Give your video a custom name for easy identification.

references.description:
Name references without @ and refer to them as @name in style.prompt. Names must be unique, ignoring case. Maximum 10 references total. Omit for no references.

Reference images for gemini-omni-1.1, wan-3.0, gemini-omni.

file_path.description:
This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

resolution.description: Output resolution. Defaults to `480p` for free tier and `720p` for paid. Supported per model: `gemini-omni-1.1`: 360p, 720p, 1080p, 4k; `wan-3.0`: 480p, 720p, 1080p; `ltx-2.5`: 480p, 720p, 1080p.

start_seconds.description: Start time of your clip (seconds). Must be ≥ 0.

prompt.description: The prompt used to edit the video.
prompt.example: Change the car color to blue

name: edit_video

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the video. If the status is not 'complete', this value is an estimate and may be adjusted upon completion based on the actual FPS of the output video. 

If video generation fails, credits will be refunded, and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the video. Use it with the [Get video Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/video-projects/get-video-details) to fetch status and downloads.

title: Edit video
